core_principles: Fusion: Terminal aesthetics x Modern SaaS polish
Density: High-density data grids, no wasted whitespace
Tension: Asymmetric layouts, visible grid lines
Motion: Living data, scanning effects, no static states

theme.strategy: The 'Terminal' Look - Deep blacks, high contrast neons, visible structure

surface_rules: No rounded corners on main dashboard panels (rounded-none or rounded-sm)
Glassmorphism only for floating overlays (toasts, sticky headers)

custom_components.name: CrawlConfigPanel
custom_components.description: Control center for the crawler. Not a simple form, but a 'Mission Control' panel.
custom_components.style: Grid layout, inputs look like terminal command lines. 'Start Crawl' button is massive, full-width or prominent.

custom_components.name: LiveTerminalLog
custom_components.description: Real-time scrolling log of crawled URLs.
custom_components.style: Black background, monospace green/white text, scanline overlay effect. Auto-scrolls.

custom_components.name: StatsOverview
custom_components.style: Bento grid layout. Big numbers (text-5xl). 'Broken Links' card should pulse red if count > 0.

custom_components.name: ResultsDataGrid
custom_components.style: Dense rows. Sticky header. Status badges. Filter bar looks like a code editor toolbar.

styling_rules.buttons: rounded-none border border-primary/50 hover:bg-primary/10 hover:border-primary transition-all uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold
styling_rules.inputs: bg-black border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 rounded-none font-mono text-sm

animations.name: scanline
animations.description: A subtle horizontal line moving down the terminal window

animations.name: grid-entrance
animations.framer_prop: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, staggerChildren: 0.1 }}

images.description: Abstract blue/green network nodes for active state or hero background
Purple abstract lines for deep crawl/analysis mode

accessibility.contrast: Ensure neon text has sufficient contrast against black backgrounds. Use APCA standards.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Disable scanlines and pulsing if prefers-reduced-motion is true.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-crawl-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. SETUP: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (terminal-black, neon-green, etc).
3. LAYOUT: Implement the 'Grid Borders' layout first. The app should look like a HUD or Dashboard.
4. COMPONENTS: Build the 'LiveTerminalLog' early - it's the 'wow' factor of this app.
5. CRITICAL: Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards. Override them to be square (rounded-none) and have a 1px border with low opacity.
6. DATA: Mock the crawl data initially to test the high-density grid layout.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
